library.name: CiftPulsarOTA
library.author: Bilgin Demir CAN (bcan77)
library.sentence: ESP32 OTA receiver for Cift Pulsar — use https://bcan77.github.io/ciftpulsar-ota/ to upload firmware (WiFi + BLE).
library.paragraph: Arduino library that receives OTA firmware updates on ESP32. To actually perform an update, open https://bcan77.github.io/ciftpulsar-ota/ in your browser (WiFi tab: enter ESP IP, select .bin, Update; BLE tab: Web Bluetooth). WiFi HTTP works on any browser/OS (AP or STA), BLE via Web Bluetooth. Includes version/update detection, mDNS, progress callbacks, and safe Update handling.

library.name: GroveI2CStepper
library.author: EBM
library.sentence: Non-blocking bipolar stepper control for Seeed Grove Mini I2C Motor Driver v1.1 (2x DRV8830).
library.paragraph: Designed for Arduino UNO R4 and other Arduino boards using the standard Wire library. Provides an AccelStepper-like speed API for a 4-wire bipolar stepper connected to the two DRV8830 channels.

library.name: libdivide
library.author: ridiculousfish
library.paragraph: libdivide.h is a header-only C/C++ library for optimizing integer division. Integer division is one of the slowest instructions on most CPUs e.g. on current x64 CPUs a 64-bit integer division has a latency of up to 90 clock cycles whereas a multiplication has a latency of only 3 clock cycles. libdivide allows you to replace expensive integer division instructions by a sequence of shift, add and multiply instructions that will calculate the integer division much faster.
